scopeExclusions.name: Wio Terminal / original reTerminal / reTerminal DM
scopeExclusions.reason: SAMD51 or Raspberry Pi / CM4 main controllers are not ESP32.

scopeExclusions.name: XIAO nRF52840 IPS / EN04 / EN05 / OpenDisplay kits
scopeExclusions.reason: The installed main controller is nRF52840, not ESP32.

scopeExclusions.name: Round Display for XIAO, SKU104030087; standalone ePaper breakout / XIAO eInk expansion accessories
scopeExclusions.reason: The specific commercial accessory does not include a main MCU. Round Display documentation requires a separately purchased XIAO. No fixed Seeed ESP32 + Round Display commercial bundle was located in the reviewed official catalog.

scopeExclusions.name: Wireless-Tag WT32 / Waveshare / M5Stack / LilyGO screen devices
scopeExclusions.reason: These are third-party brands sold by the store, not Seeed-brand devices.

scopeExclusions.name: Standalone XIAO processor-only development boards outside a display kit
scopeExclusions.reason: These belong to the MCU/XIAO category and have no bundled display in the specified HMI/Display scope. Their explicit EE display board and kit products are included above.

history.note: This historical execution evidence remains scoped to its original devices, image hashes and WASM revision; it is not inherited by new SKUs or kit selections.

scopeNotes: Current warehouse stock is a changing storefront condition, not evidence that an existing hardware SKU should be erased from adaptation scope.

EE04 offers 12 specific screen options; EE05 offers 11. EE02 and EE03 each offer one. A generic selection-guide table listing 10.3/13.3 inches is not used to invent electrically incompatible EE04/EE05 combinations.

The original search page is dynamically rendered and did not yield a complete static stock result. Scope was cross-checked against official display category, exact storefront items, manufacturer PDFs, and pinned hardware/firmware inventories.
Round Display remains excluded only as a standalone accessory with no integrated controller. This is not a statement that users cannot attach an ESP32.
